column1: # RECIPE_MEMORY.tsv - append-only lesson memory of qualification/treemap-aba-guard-20261107: one row per lesson, appended in the same commit as the correction.

column4: a height (liveness) check on the erased slot cannot see slot reuse: guard the lookup that produced the slot, not the write that consumes it, and keep the liveness check only as a backstop
column5: #2641 review (AbaProbe shape 1): remove(2) erased 60 and returned v60 with eraseAt's height check passing; mutant TM-1 (height check removed) is noticed by no oracle once the lookups are guarded

column4: a revision check at the end of a lookup is too late inside a walk: after the comparator changed the structure the walk follows stale links and hands the comparator a released slot's key (null) before the end check runs; check after every comparator call of a walk
column5: first trial (end-of-lookup guards only): remove(6)/get(6)/put(6)/defer(6) and bounded firstEntry/lastKey/pollFirstEntry/higherKey ended in the comparator's NullPointerException; Tree.find/Tree.near walked() and the put/defer descent checks turned them into ConcurrentModificationException

column4: a read-modify-write split over two public operations (compute/merge/computeIfAbsent/putIfAbsent read the old value, then call put) needs put to read the revision before its own admission comparator calls, or a mutation there is a lost update
column5: compute(write) on bounded views at calls 4-6 wrote v2! (derived from the pre-mutation v2) into the post-mutation map; mutant AG-11 (late revision read in put) reproduces it

column4: a comparator call made before any slot is read (findSlot's bound probes, near's type check, defer's admission) needs no check: the walk that follows sees the changed structure consistently and the outcome equals running the comparator's mutation first; do not add checks whose mutants every oracle must let survive
column5: the shapes self test accepts the action-then-operation outcome; the end-of-findSlot and near-early-return checks of the first trial were dropped as redundant behind the walk checks

column4: put a guard in the owner's own locators, not at the ~40 shared base-class call sites; when a shared body must change (the cursor's epoch order), first prove it neutral for every other owner by reading their locators, not by assumption
column5: an early draft of DECISION S1 claimed M3WeakHashMap.firstSlot changes the revision; its drain() erases with structural=false (no modifications++), so reading the epoch before firstSlot in M3SlotMap.slots is neutral for the hash owners

column4: a fail-fast guard inside a lookup that cursor constructors call moves the failure into iterator creation, which a landed contract forbids ('capture epoch before firstSlot': the first call throws); give cursor construction a non-throwing start (cursorStart: a structural change yields -1) and read the cursor's epoch before it
column5: first full build: M3FilteredCursorReadinessTest (P2-098) failed with the walk's CME thrown from M3SlotMap.slots' initializer; with cursorStart + epoch-first slots() it passes and the shapes self test adds creation(structural) and creation(comparator's own CME)

column4: an oracle must record a failure of a step it never saw fail (cursor creation), not crash on it, and the change must leave every earlier output byte-identical
column5: this leaf's first design failed inside iterator creation (27 opens, 6 reopens in the trial run) and the unfixed oracle reopened outside its try; FilteredViewsOwnerDifferential now records a failed (re)open as a counted line and reopens lazily; its outputs on #2641's base and head classes still hash to the recorded 4b163e64 and d9494e8d

column4: an owner guard that duplicates earlier view checks turns their killed mutants into survivors; keep the checks as defense in depth only with proof: a pair mutant removing the check together with the guards claimed to cover it must be KILLED, and when a pair survives, the oracle has a gap to close first
column5: after this leaf RO-1/RO-5/RO-6/RO-7/MU-3/MU-4 (#2641) and AG-6 survived alone; their pairs P-* are KILLED; P-AG-6 survived until the shapes self test drained mutable filtered descending cursors (a released slot's null key returned before the failure)
